title: Windows Performance Diagnostics Toolkit Report
description: Schema for diagnostic-plan.json (Plan mode) and diagnostic-manifest.json (Collect mode) emitted by the Windows Performance Diagnostics Toolkit. Schema 1.3 adds the optional v2 tier, coverage, data-quality, evidence-index, inventory, telemetry, incident, finding, escalation and technician-report surfaces without invalidating 1.0-1.2 manifests.

remoteTarget.description: Present only in remote mode: the computer the collection runs on.

minidumps.description: Present when -CollectMinidumps was requested. Plan mode advertises the scope; Collect mode reports the outcome. Source dumps are copied read-only; MEMORY.DMP is metadata only.

bootFailureLogs.description: Present when -CollectBootFailureLogs was requested. Plan mode advertises the scope; Collect mode reports per-source outcome. Oversized logs are recorded with skippedReason 'oversized', never truncated.

package.description: Present when -ZipOutput was requested. Plan mode advertises the destination and name pattern; Collect mode reports the produced case zip. The zip contains only this run's whitelisted artifacts plus the manifest.

remote.description: Present when -RemoteComputer was requested. Plan mode advertises the target and transport; Collect mode reports the pull-back result. The tool never enables WinRM on the target.

servicingAnalysis.description: Bounded aggregate signatures from copied CBS, DISM, setup and boot logs. Raw lines remain only in their copied log artifacts.

network.description: In Plan mode: the planned read-only network-state sub-collections. In Collect mode: the DNS-vs-ping split-test summary and security-software match counts from the captured network-state.json.

symptom.description: Optional user-reported symptom context. Present in both Plan and Collect modes when -SymptomContext is provided. Records the reported symptom separately from the collection window timestamps.

reported.description: The user-provided symptom description. Absent when only a preset was supplied.

preset.description: Optional collection preset chosen by the user.

collectionWindow.description: Timestamps recording when the symptom was reported and when collection occurred.

requestedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the user reported the symptom.

startedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when collection started (Collect mode only).

completedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when collection completed (Collect mode only).

diskMetrics.description: Per-disk I/O summary metrics from Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfDisk_PhysicalDisk (last sample). Null when CIM classes are unavailable (e.g. non-Windows hosts, restricted tokens). Sustained disk findings use the paired raw-counter series in the disk-samples.json artifact, not this summary.

volumeMetrics.description: Per-volume free space from Win32_Volume. Null when CIM classes are unavailable.

memoryMetrics.description: Memory committed bytes, commit limit, available bytes, and paging indicators from Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_Memory. Null when CIM classes are unavailable.

pageFaultsPerSec.description: Total page faults per second (soft+hard). Not equivalent to hard faults alone.

pageReadsPerSec.description: Hard page faults: pages read from disk to resolve page faults.

pagesInputPerSec.description: Pages moved from disk to memory (hard fault input).

performanceMode.description: Plan-mode advertisement of the concurrent incident-capture stages.

captureWindow.description: The single wall-clock window shared by counters, process/commit, GPU, disk, UDP and the WPR trace, with requested-vs-actual durations.

incident.description: Incident-marker bookkeeping: when the operator marked the slowdown and how many samples were retained before/after it.

processMemory.description: Per-process commit attribution summary; the full repeated series lives in process-memory-samples.csv.

gpu.description: GPU attribution summary; per-process engine utilization and dedicated/shared memory live in gpu-metrics.json.

pageFile.description: Pagefile size, current usage, peak usage and location per pagefile (Win32_PageFileUsage; sizes in MiB).

kernelPool.description: System-wide paged/nonpaged kernel pool summary; the repeated series lives in kernel-pool-samples.json.

storageMapping.description: Drive letter -> physical disk mapping plus pagefile placement, so low free space on an unrelated archive volume is not misread as a performance cause.

incidentEvents.description: Incident-window event correlation: which logs were read, how many events fell inside the window, and that out-of-window events are labelled rather than dropped.

liveKernelReports.description: LiveKernelReports on disk (WHEA/TDR residue), read-only metadata.

secretsCollected.description: False in Plan (no evidence collected); null in Collect because raw evidence has not been scanned for secrets.

manifest.description: The root Plan or Collect manifest contract. The root schema properties remain authoritative; this named definition makes the contract addressable to downstream validators.
